gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Timekilling Time and Murder on the WARP Express records for the Normal story encounters. Guide variants 滅多切り and そんな･･･。 map to Mutilate and My...; middle-dot ellipses map to the original Cassetti skill names. Thirst for Blood and Tenacious follow mowe passive records, not similarly named statuses or other bosses. Normal, dungeon, and Hard values and target/deployment restrictions remain distinct. Hard-only names are referenced only to explain their exclusion.

stageName.text: Murder on the WARP Express: The One Who Commands

lead.text: Prepare against the Bloodbags and Sasha, then reduce Cassetti's Stored Blood through clash wins and HP damage. Use Evade against the Unclashable area attack at 0 blood to limit his massive lifesteal recovery.

listLead.text: Prepare against bloodbags and the opening enemy, then reduce the later enemy's stored blood with Clash Wins and HP damage. Evade the Unclashable area attack at 0 blood and prevent large lifesteal healing.

statNote.text: Normal 6.5-28. Covers Wave 1's Bloodbags and Sasha, then Wave 2's Cassetti. Bloodbags list both maximum HP and halved HP on entry. Separate from Hard's extra passives and values.

skillNote.text: Cassetti has both Clashable and Unclashable area attacks. “Activate Prosthesis” and Counter also differ by user; check who is using them. Cassetti's Evade Defense Level is unlisted.

priorities.0.text: Aim for Level 45 and Uptie III or higher, with Blunt/Envy damage and healing. Build SP and E.G.O resources in the first wave.

priorities.1.text: Prioritize clashes that reduce Stored Blood. Hits on Bleeding allies enable enemy healing and buffs.

priorities.2.text: The area attack at 0 blood is Unclashable. Use Evade to limit healing; stop the later Clashable area attack with powerful skills.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Cassetti repeatedly heals nearly to full

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Hits on Bleeding Sinners trigger lifesteal. The Speed 10 special area attack greatly strengthens it; letting everyone be hit causes massive recovery. Use Evade against the Unclashable version and win clashes against other area attacks.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: It drops by 1 per 5% maximum HP lost, and winning against “The Parade's Prince” or Blood... Blood... Blood...! reduces it too. Some hits increase it instead; combine damage and clash wins.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: A Bleed team cannot finish the fight

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Bleed on Cassetti himself strengthens Offense/Defense Levels and clashes, and he resists Bleed damage. Try direct Blunt/Envy damage rather than relying on Bleed buildup alone.

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: As Wave 1 enemies disappear, Sasha gains slots up to 5. Check the additional attack lines and use her 50% HP Stagger to stop attacks.

units.0.notes.0.text: Enters with 5 Stored Blood. The first drop to 0 changes patterns and brings a Speed 10 Unclashable area attack.

units.0.notes.1.text: Gains Bloodtinged Craving at 30% HP (about 513). Hits on high-Bleed Sinners heal him; prevent hits as well as dealing damage.

units.1.notes.0.text: Reinforces Wave 1 after 5 cumulative enemy deaths. Starts with 3 slots and gains up to 5 as other enemies disappear.

units.1.notes.1.text: Charge skills change at 50% HP or lower. Self-damage cannot kill her; finish with Sinner attacks.

units.2.notes.0.text: The Wave 1 version enters at half HP due to Burst Bloodbag. Does not use regular-stage or Hard values.

units.2.notes.1.text: All types are vulnerable to Blunt and Envy. Handle reinforcements while building the main team's SP and E.G.O resources.

units.3.notes.0.text: The Wave 1 version enters at half HP due to Burst Bloodbag. Does not use regular-stage or Hard values.

units.3.notes.1.text: All types are vulnerable to Blunt and Envy. Handle reinforcements while building the main team's SP and E.G.O resources.

units.4.notes.0.text: The Wave 1 version enters at half HP due to Burst Bloodbag. Does not use regular-stage or Hard values.

units.4.notes.1.text: All types are vulnerable to Blunt and Envy. Handle reinforcements while building the main team's SP and E.G.O resources.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare main Blunt attackers and Sinners with Evade

phases.0.steps.0.text: Aim for Level 45 and Uptie III or higher, choosing leveled Identities that exploit ×1.5 Blunt and Envy. This chain encounter allows 6 Sinners plus 6 reserves; check reserve order and levels too.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Heavy Bleed on Cassetti buffs him. If a Bleed team stalls, switch to available direct damage and bring HP/SP recovery.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Evade users can limit healing from the Unclashable area attack. Prepare resistance and remaining HP on Sinners without Evade.

phases.1.title.text: Raise main attackers' SP through easy clashes

phases.1.steps.0.text: Begins with 5 half-HP passengers. Cleanup Agents and Prosthetic Fixers reinforce after kills; the wave does not end with the initial 5.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Assign winning clashes to main attackers for SP and resources. Bloodbags also heal by hitting Bleeding allies; do not leave weak enemies alive to cause attrition.

phases.1.steps.2.text: When Sasha appears, check remaining enemies and attack lines. Her slots increase as adds disappear; use Blunt to reach the 50% HP Stagger and follow up.

phases.1.steps.3.text: Sasha increases Charge through self-damage. Do not wait for that alone to defeat her; finish while saving resources for the next wave.

phases.2.title.text: Prevent hits and reduce Stored Blood and HP

phases.2.steps.0.text: Stored Blood caps at 10 and drops by 1 per 5% maximum HP lost. Wins against “The Parade's Prince” and certain other skills reduce it further. Stop dangerous clashes while dealing direct damage.

phases.2.steps.1.text: High-Bleed Sinners attract attacks and enable healing and skill bonuses. Redirect to lower-Bleed Sinners, and Offset Evade with defense.

phases.2.steps.2.text: “The Parade's Prince” gains area coverage based on the number of Bleeding Sinners. Its 4 hits can heal substantially; stop it with a strong skill or E.G.O.

phases.3.title.text: Evade the Speed 10 Unclashable area attack

phases.3.steps.0.text: “I Am... The Prince... of the Parade...!” is Unclashable and prevents Stagger that turn. A powerful E.G.O clash cannot stop it.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Hits on Bleeding targets trigger enhanced lifesteal and massive healing. Evade where possible to reduce hits; prioritize endangered Sinners.

phases.3.steps.2.text: After attacking, Stored Blood returns to 10 and the turn ends. Do not plan to finish him with later attacks; prepare to reduce blood again next turn.

phases.4.timing.text: After the pattern change / at 30% HP or lower

phases.4.title.text: Stop the Clashable finisher and finish the fight

phases.4.steps.0.text: After the pattern change, low blood brings “I'm... Never... Going Back...!” This one is Clashable; retain a strong handler or E.G.O to prevent hits.

phases.4.steps.1.text: This skill also gains 10 blood after attacking. Winning does not stop that gain; prepare for the next buffs and further HP damage.

phases.4.steps.2.text: At 30% HP or lower, Bloodtinged Craving adds blood on each hit. Prevent healing in the closing phase and combine clash wins with follow-up damage on the same turn.

skills.0.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has 4+ Bleed, Clash Power +1

skills.0.response.text: Clash Power increases against 4+ Bleed. Redirect to a healthy, lower-Bleed Sinner to prevent healing and further Bleed.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.1.response.text: Increases Bleed Count. Letting it hit a high-Bleed Sinner worsens later area attacks and healing conditions.

skills.2.response.text: Adds Bleed Potency and Count, with extra damage from the target's Count. Stop it by clashing rather than repeatedly healing through hits.

skills.5.response.text: Evade gains Base Power from the target's Bleed Count. Offset it with defense to enable boss damage. Defense Level is unlisted.

skills.7.effects.8.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1

skills.8.effects.0.text: [On Use] At 10+ Charge Count, consume 3 for +1 Coin Power

skills.8.effects.1.text: [On Use] At 15+ Charge Count, consume 3 additional Count for +20% damage

skills.8.effects.2.text: [On Use] Below 5 Charge Count, lose 10% maximum HP and gain 5 Charge Count

skills.9.effects.0.text: [On Use] At 10+ Charge Count, consume 3 for +1 Coin Power

skills.10.effects.0.text: [On Use] Consume 10% own maximum HP and gain 15 Charge Count

skills.10.response.text: Consumes 10% HP for 15 Charge. Do not wait for self-damage alone; stop its attack and follow with Blunt damage to Stagger and kill.

skills.11.effects.0.text: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 3 own Bleed Count (max 2)

skills.11.response.text: Offset with defense or focus enough damage to break through. Avoid losing skills needed for the next dangerous clash to a Shield.

skills.12.effects.0.text: [On Use] At 10+ Charge Count, consume 3 for +1 Coin Power

skills.13.effects.0.text: [On Use] Consume 10% own maximum HP and gain 15 Charge Count

skills.13.response.text: A powerful Charge skill Sasha uses at 50% HP or lower. Prevent Bleed and Offense Level Down, then concentrate damage after Stagger to defeat her.

skills.14.response.text: Increases Bleed Count. Give main attackers easy clashes to build SP for later enemies.

skills.15.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.15.response.text: Adds Bleed Count despite low Power. Clear Bloodbags with winning clashes and Blunt follow-ups to limit attrition.

skills.16.effects.0.text: If the target has 10+ Bleed, damage +20%

skills.16.effects.3.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Absorb up to 10 Bleed Potency from the target and heal (absorbed Potency × 2)% of maximum HP

skills.17.response.text: An ordinary Counter. Check resistance and Stagger thresholds on the first attacker to avoid a fatal initiating hit. Attack type also varies by user.

skills.18.response.text: Charge rises on use and on hit. Prevent hits and avoid leaving reinforcements alive for long.

skills.19.response.text: Builds Charge and Bleed. Has more HP than regular passengers; focus Blunt or other effective damage before it heals.

skills.20.effects.0.text: [On Use] Consume all Charge Count, lose 2 × (15 − consumed Charge Count)% of maximum HP, and gain +2 Coin Power

skills.20.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Offense Level Down.

skills.20.response.text: Consumes Charge and HP for stronger Coins, then absorbs Bleed and heals on the last Coin. Its maximum exceeds the base display; check buffed predictions.

skills.21.effects.0.text: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 3 own Bleed Count (max 2)

skills.23.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Below 5 own Charge Count, gain 5 Charge Count, 3 Bleed Count, and 1 Fragile

skills.24.response.text: Self-damage and Charge occur on use; hits inflict Bleed and Paralyze. Focus the enemy after self-damage without allowing its charged attacks through.

passives.0.effect.text:
At Turn End, depending on Stored Blood:
- At 5 or lower, gain 1 Bind, 1 Fragile, and 1 Offense Level Down next turn per stack below 5.
- Above 5, gain 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up next turn per excess stack.

passives.0.response.text: Low blood weakens him; above 5, Offense/Defense Levels rise. Reduce it through clash wins and HP damage.

passives.1.effect.text:
Change patterns the first time Stored Blood reaches 0.
When using “I Am... The Prince... of the Parade...!”, Speed is fixed at 10.

passives.1.response.text: Prepare Evade for the next Speed 10 Unclashable area attack. Reaching 0 blood does not make everything safe.

passives.2.effect.text: At 30% maximum HP remaining, gain Bloodtinged Craving

passives.2.response.text: Hits now increase blood. Assign winning handlers to dangerous clashes, especially when trying to finish.

passives.3.effect.text:
Prioritize the target with the highest total Bleed Potency and Count.
On Hit against a target with Bleed, heal 2% maximum HP.

passives.3.response.text: High-Bleed Sinners attract attacks and enable major healing. Prevent hits through clashes or Evade.

passives.4.effect.text:
While self has Bleed:
- Gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up per 5 Bleed (max 10).
- Gain 1 Clash Power Up per 10 Bleed (max 5).
- Take 50% less Bleed damage (rounded down).

passives.4.response.text: Bleed strengthens the enemy's Offense/Defense Levels and clashes. If a Bleed team stalls, switch to direct Blunt/Envy damage.

passives.5.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.5.condition.text: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type

passives.5.response.text: Do not rely on replacing its Panic type. Normal SP reduction and clash wins can still be useful separately.

passives.6.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.6.response.text: Panic does not last indefinitely. Concentrate damage before recovery.

passives.7.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.7.response.text: Panic does not last indefinitely. Concentrate damage before recovery.

passives.8.response.text: Hits add Bleed Count, converted to Coagulated Blood at Turn End. Longer fights raise Offense/Defense Levels; defeat enemies one at a time.

passives.9.effect.text:
Prioritize Bleeding targets.
If no damage was dealt this turn, gain 2 Fragile and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.

passives.9.condition.text: Bleeding-target selection / a turn without dealing damage

passives.9.response.text: Preventing damage gives the enemy Fragile but also Offense Level Up. Recheck predictions and focus its weaknesses.

passives.10.response.text: If the enemy has Charge left, transfers Charge Count to that skill's attacker. Can support available Charge Identities but is not required.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Max 10; starts Wave 2 at 5. Lose 1 per 5% maximum HP lost. Also decreases on certain clash losses, and increases on hits or after special area attacks. High blood raises Offense/Defense Levels; low blood weakens them.

warnings.0.text: Distinguish the Unclashable area attack from the later Clashable one. Evade is the main response to the former; clash wins to the latter.

warnings.1.text: Ordinary Guard reduces damage but does not prevent the hit itself. It does not suppress lifesteal like Evade.

warnings.2.text: The first drop to 0 Stored Blood risks massive healing. Check the displayed skill instead of choosing only attacks at 0 blood.

warnings.3.text: Do not apply Hard-only Nightmare of La Manchaland or its SP recovery conditions to this Normal version.

Prepare against the Bloodbags and Sasha, then reduce Cassetti's Stored Blood through clash wins and HP damage.
